consumer: The engine's reload-option enumeration (item_location::reload / can_reload plus ammo-candidate gathering) asking 'is there exactly one unambiguous compatible ammo so no selection menu is raised?'
scope: The reload-candidate set over the gun's own magazine and the reachable/nearby inventory (not merely carried items), reduced to the single-unambiguous-candidate decision
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items - dumps a flat list of wielded/worn/inventory items (type_id, name, charges, count_by_charges), raw simulation state with no reload-compatibility computation
divergence: A gun with a partial magazine plus one matching ammo stack carried, or the only compatible ammo on an adjacent tile/vehicle: the item dump shows ammo present/absent but cannot say whether the engine would raise an ammo-selection menu, so the single-unambiguous answer is wrong
